load_obj_mesh: load a 3D mesh from an OBJ file returning vertices, faces, normals, and texture data as PyTorch tensors
load_objs_as_meshes: load multiple OBJ files and return them as a PyTorch3D Meshes object with optional UV textures or texture atlas
save_obj_mesh: save a 3D mesh with vertices, faces, normals, and UV texture map to an OBJ file with associated MTL and PNG files
parse_obj_face: parse an OBJ face line extracting vertex, texture, and normal indices then triangulate faces with more than 3 vertices
format_faces_indices: convert 1-based OBJ face indices to 0-based PyTorch tensors handling negative indexing and padding values
